name: @letbuyy/lcis-tracking
description: LCTS — Change Tracking System. Read-only semantic change intelligence over the LCIS platform: change timeline, semantic snapshot diff, impact, owners, risk, rollback guidance, and per-subject history with reasons. Tracks what DID change; never mutates, never executes. Live change events (commits/deployments) are honestly NOT_CONNECTED until adapter facts are injected.
